sections.title: A quiet kind of presence.
sections.body: An exploration of weight, proportion and light. Sculptural forms conceived to feel as considered in the hand as they look from across a room.

image.alt: Generated concept of a sculptural gold cuff resting on pale limestone.

items.label: 01 / Form
items.title: The open curve
items.body: A continuous line, softened at its edges. The starting point for a small family of sculptural pieces.

items.label: 02 / Surface
items.title: Light in motion
items.body: Polished planes meet quieter textures. Contrast gives each imagined object its character.

items.label: 03 / Proportion
items.title: Made to be noticed
items.body: A study in balance: generous volume, clean profiles and room for the material to speak.
